text:
Maya Patel: re-opening the PM follow-up from Thu's storage degradation. looks like 3 action items didn't get owners: RED-4410, RED-4411, RED-4412. can we assign and set due dates? cc @Carmen @Ethan @Lena
Carmen Ruiz: I can pick up RED-4410 (alert thresholds + dashboard panels). small infra tweaks + grafana work. estimate 4 business days. will add AC.
Ethan Park: i'll take RED-4412 (autoscale policy tweak + test harness). need infra sign-off for canary. ETA ~1 week if infra available.
Lena Gomez: RED-4411 is product/customer comms + runbook; I'll own that side and coordinate with CS. one week timeline.
ops-bot: attached: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal/incident/2024-05-02/storage-throttle.log; created links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4410 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4411 https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4412
Maya Patel: quick RACI suggestion: Carmen R/A for 4410, Lena A for 4411, Ethan R for 4412, Maya I, Sylvia C. agree? also require acceptance criteria + rollback + test plan on each ticket by EOD Fri so we can cover in ops review.
Carmen Ruiz: agreed. just added preliminary AC to RED-4410: alert fires <5% false positives, dashboard shows 1h/6h/24h view, runbook includes mitigation steps.
Ethan Park: noted dependency: need a dev image with the new autoscaler flags and perf baseline. @eng-infra can you help prioritize 2h setup?
Sylvia Chen: product side approves Lena owning comms. i'll review customer note before send. i also agree we should track as a recurring pattern and add a detection ticket.
Lena Gomez: will draft the CS note and attach to CS-102. pinging CS and legal for any wording constraints.
Maya Patel: created RED-4413 for recurring-pattern detection and assigned to Research/Signal for scoping. want a discovery doc in 2 sprints.
triage-bot: reminder set: "pm-followup-update" in 48h. owners must update tickets with AC/rollback/test by 2024-06-07.
Carmen Ruiz: scheduled pairing with eng-infra for dashboard/alerts on 2024-05-30 10:00 PT.
Ethan Park: opened RED-4412 and added a blocking tag for infra-image. linking to a small test harness repo: https://git.redwood-inference/auto-test/4412.
Lena Gomez: RED-4411 updated with runbook stub and draft customer note. expecting Sylvia signoff by Tue.
Maya Patel: summary of action dates: Carmen -> RED-4410 due 2024-06-05; Ethan -> RED-4412 due 2024-06-10; Lena -> RED-4411 due 2024-06-07; RED-4413 (detection) discovery target 2024-06-21. I'll include these in weekly ops review.
Carmen Ruiz: flagging one follow-up: add regression eval after rollout (post-deploy smoke). adding checklist item to RED-4410.
Ethan Park: if infra can't deliver image in time, can we pivot to a smaller canary with existing nodes? asking for contingency.
Sylvia Chen: yes, contingency is fine but document assumptions in ticket. also linking CS-102 for customer comms tracking.
Maya Patel: action items recap: 1) owners assigned and tickets updated by EOD Fri, 2) Engel-infra pairing scheduled for Carmen, 3) RED-4413 created to track recurring pattern, 4) I'll follow up in ops review. reopen thread if any owner changes. :white_check_mark:
